description: Cmd/Ctrl+Enter to submit and a soft minimum-input quality nudge. Power users can now generate from any input with a keyboard shortcut. When a topic is fewer than 8 characters or a textarea is fewer than 30 characters, AIToolPage shows a non-blocking warning toast with a 'Generate anyway' link instead of immediately calling AI on a thin prompt.
steps: Add a handleFormKeyDown handler on the form Card that calls handleGenerate() on Meta/Ctrl + Enter.
Add aria-keyshortcuts on the Generate button so assistive tech announces the shortcut.
Render a small 'Tip: press Cmd/Ctrl+Enter…' hint under the Generate button.
Implement a qualityNudge(values) helper that returns a human message when topic-style fields are <8 chars or textareas are <30 chars.
On submit, fire the nudge as a toast with a 'Generate anyway' action button that calls handleGenerate({ skipNudge: true }).
acceptance_criteria: Cmd/Ctrl + Enter from any input triggers generation when the form is valid.
Short inputs trigger a soft warning, not a blocking error.
'Generate anyway' bypasses the nudge for the current click.
verification: Manual: type 'Maths' into a topic field, press Cmd+Enter, observe the nudge with the action.
findings: Nudge heuristics use the field label (matches /topic|focus|lesson|task/i) so they apply uniformly across tools without per-tool config.
